segments.text: Phil and Claire usually go to the same Italian restaurant every year. After seeing the huge romantic gift Dylan gives Haley, Phil worries that their own tradition has become boring. He suggests spending the night at a hotel and trying some role-playing.

segments.text: At the hotel bar, Phil pretends to be a businessman named Clive Bixby, while Claire becomes a mysterious woman named Julianna. Their first attempt goes badly because Phil starts complaining about his real wife without realizing it.

segments.text: As they head upstairs, the coat gets caught in the escalator. Claire can’t take it off, so she and Phil are trapped there while people they know keep stopping to talk to them.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay takes Gloria to see a comedian he has loved for years. Gloria wanted to go salsa dancing, but Jay is sure she’ll enjoy the show. Things are fine until the comedian notices their age difference and starts making jokes about Jay being an old man with a younger wife.
